basic_info.description: Perfectly situated between Mission Dolores & Noe Valley, this thoughtfully renovated Dolores Heights residence offers nearly 1,400 square feet of refined living space. Early 20th-century character blends seamlessly w/ modern upgrades: soaring ceilings, intricate moldings, two gas fireplaces, solid light oak wood floors, custom cedar double-pane windows, & bespoke built-ins. The chef's kitchen boasts Bosch appliances, custom cabinetry, a slim-profile microwave hood, & a Spanish tile backsplash. Two spa-inspired baths showcase premium fixtures from Hansgrohe, Grohe, Duravit, & Kohler, along with a Duravit soaking tub, floating vanities, Italian tile, and wall-hung toilets for a sleek, modern feel. Beyond the interiors, an expansive double lot offers a lush, private garden with lemon and fig trees, plus furnished outdoor living & entertaining spaces. The building features smart video surveillance, Nest video doorbells & Smoke/CO2 detectors, & a keypad-controlled entry gate, all supported by strong HOA reserves. Steps from Valencia Street and Dolores Park, 1336A Guerrero delivers the best of San Francisco living historic charm, thoughtful upgrades at the intersection of the best San Francisco neighborhoods. Leased parking is available one block away. | See more at LifeinNoeValley.com
